main_idea: PivotRL training raises Qwen3.5-9B pass@5 on τ³-Banking from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: Training raises τ³-Banking pass@5 from 11.3% to 17.5%.
Training combines teacher distillation with PivotRL on 50 tasks.
The selected checkpoint shows no significant change on six general benchmarks.
summary: The pass@5 comparison is clear, but the method pipeline, training statistics, subtitle, and extra branding crowd it.
